thesis: Vacant life-science shells are the AI tour.
dek: Since COVID, science development raced demand. Demand died. The leftover product — power, HVAC, floor load, docks, clean-room-capable MEP — is what AI, advanced R&D, robotics, and advanced manufacturing can occupy now. Vacant new-construction LS shells are the overbuild proof. 150 Industrial is the closed conversion.
proofLines: Former Novartis / San Carlos Research Center. 230,961 SF. Moran Team transaction.
